en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street in a European town. On both sides are early‑20th‑century townhouses and shopfronts with German signage. In the background stands a tall church tower with clock and slender spire dominating the streetscape. A horse‑drawn carriage is traveling along the street toward the foreground. The scene is quiet, with no motor cars visible.
